db:info.db:title: MyContainer Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename T> class MyContainer
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Tests that template container parameters appear with generic signatures

db:abstract.db:para: A container class for testing template parameter type matching.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: T is the element type stored in the container.
MyContainer exercises the code path in findNodeForCursor where template parameter types must match between header parsing and \fn re-parsing.

db:section.db:title: void MyContainer::replace(int index, const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Replaces the item at index with value.

db:section.db:title: MyContainer<T> MyContainer::operator+(const MyContainer<T> &other) const
db:section.db:para: Returns a container that is the concatenation of this container and other.
